proof_scope: Report scoping, phase boundaries, phase honesty, target-derived research, gap synthesis, and cleanup-tail safety through the real ./run.sh/project_state.py entrypoints. Each load-bearing project-state pipeline step has an explicit capability claim, seam, and live readback case.

claims.proves: Quick, standard, full, and cleanup-tail project-state paths emit the expected phase structure for a real target; Phase 1 reports target-owned tests/skills without global fallback; Phase 2/5 availability reflects successful recall/search answers; Phase 3/4/6 emit doc-drift, best-practices, and gap-analysis sections; and cleanup-tail writes a readiness bundle without delete/move authority.
claims.does_not_prove: That recall/research results are semantically relevant, that doc-drift findings are all true positives, that best-practices findings are exhaustive, that external services are always available, or that a passing state report means the target project is healthy. Paths are pinned to this workstation.

capability_claims.description: Phase 1 infrastructure describes the selected PROJECT_STATE_ROOT: target-owned tests are collected and skill inventory is not borrowed from the global skill tree for a single-skill target.
Phase 2 memory availability is derived from parseable successful recall responses, not from the mere presence of the memory skill file.
Phase 3 doc-code drift emits a machine-readable drift section in non-quick reports for the target project.
Phase 4 best-practices scanning emits a machine-readable findings section in non-quick reports for the target project.
Phase 5 full-mode research builds queries from the target project instead of template terms and reports availability only when at least one search lane answers.
Phase 6 gap analysis emits a structured gaps/improvements object synthesized from the collected phases.
Quick mode remains Phase 1 plus Phase 6 only, while standard/full expose the broader phase set without disguising skipped external research as success.
cleanup-tail writes the readiness bundle and preserves the safety boundary that project-state never authorizes deletion or cleanup mutation.
quick, standard, and full project-state JSON reports declare project_state.report.v1 so ecosystem consumers do not receive anonymous contract payloads.
project-state reports are generated through pydantic models with a JSON Schema contract, and schema failures are routed through triage-error.
project-state renders human-legible Markdown from a saved pydantic-valid JSON report instead of using Markdown as the source of truth.
project-state self-heals pydantic validation failures by routing through triage-error, writing a valid repair skeleton, and embedding the triage code in Phase 6.
